main_text.l: Thomas Morus, Anglus, vir ingeniosus, Vtopiæ insulæ à se confictæ incolas linguâ peculiari scribit uti, & characteres etiam fingit proprios.

l.i: Tetrastichon vernaculâ Vtopiensium linguâ à Moro positum.

main_text.l: Vtopos haboccas peula chama polta chamaan.
Bargol he maglomi maglomi baccan soma gymnosophaon,
Vtopus me dux ex non insula fecit insulam.
Vna ego terrarum omnium absque philosophia:
Libenter impartio mea, non gravatim accipio meliora.
De Zigaris vel Cingaris, quos Germani Zigeuner vocant.
ANno post Christum natum 1417., vt scribit Munsterus, primùm in Germania

page.notes: The initial "A" of the last paragraph is a large woodcut initial, joined to "Anno" as "ANno" in the scan; the word is printed "Anno" with the woodcut A. The paragraph continues beyond the page ("mania" at the foot is the end of "Germania", split across the line; the word is printed "Germania" with the final letters "mania" visible at the lower right). The word "Germania" is broken at the end of the page's last visible line: read as "primùm in Germania" and the lower line "mania" is the continuation. Some words are rendered with uncertain letters ("Ginaris" etc.); the heading "Zigaris" and "Cingaris" are read as printed. Long s is plain s throughout.
